name: Yokodori ~Omae no Mono wa Ore no Mono~
original_name: よこどり～おまえのものはおれのもの～
source:
Have you ever been sick of a couple in front of you? Zero company gives you a chance to destroy that couple and take away women in six different stories.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-august-2000-tsukihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
你是否曾對眼前卿卿我我的情侶感到厭煩？Zero將在六個不同的故事裡，給你拆散情侶、奪走女方的機會。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-august-2000-tsukihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
